purpose: Prevent sensory precision from becoming voyeurism, diagnosis, prediction, shame, or unreviewed instruction.

risk_controls.blocked_claim: This sound means X hours remain.
risk_controls.allowed_posture: This sound has been described near the end of life in some sources; ask the care team for context.

risk_controls.blocked_claim: This smell means a specific disease or bad care.
risk_controls.allowed_posture: Smell may be part of end-of-life memory and may have many causes; preserve dignity and route clinical claims to review.

risk_controls.blocked_claim: Anyone should touch, move, wash, or dress the person this way.
risk_controls.allowed_posture: Touch is contextual, consented, culturally situated, and safety-bounded.

risk_controls.blocked_claim: This song or animal behavior proves awareness, acceptance, or imminent death.
risk_controls.allowed_posture: Music and animals may matter to the room; interpretation stays bounded.

risk_controls.blocked_claim: Publish a child’s sensory memory because it is powerful.
risk_controls.allowed_posture: Child sensory material is highest-gate and probably private.

review_contract: clinical review for body sound/smell/touch claims
dignity review for all sensory vividness
identifiability review for objects and rooms
tradition-holder review if objects/music/body care is ritual material
high-gate child review for any child witness material
